asciiEquivalence.oldRejectedSet: U+0000 through U+001F inclusive, and U+007F
asciiEquivalence.newPredicate: For each StringIterator character, first UTF16 code unit <=0x1f or ===0x7f
asciiEquivalence.proof: Each ASCII code point is one identical UTF16 unit; every nonASCII scalar begins with a code unit >=128 and isolated surrogates are >=0xD800, so neither predicate rejects it. Empty strings yield false in both. Both are existential over the same ASCII-member set; command trim and all other row predicates remain exact.

callbackEquivalence: Only failure boolean storage becomes a typed mutable object property. Initfalse/catchtrue/afterawaitread/closedthrow and synchronous listener-capture-marker-cancel sequence remain exact after representation normalization. No callback await, timer or new promise.
